name: Sika® Foam Backer Rod Open Cell

cl.x: Provide Sika® Foam Backer Rod Open Cell where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02).
Sika® Foam Backer Rod Open Cell is manufactured from extruded, open cell polyurethane foam, available in rods with different diameters and lengths.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.x: Sika® Foam Backer Rod Open Cell is used as a back up material for cold applied Sika sealants to give the sealant the correct thickness. It also acts as a bondbreaker, permitting the most efficient joint design.

cl.c: Data sheet page 1: Product Information > Packaging

cl.x: Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) states no substrate preparation requirements.
Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.

During installation avoid excessive longitudinal stretching of the rod. For Hot poured sealants consult our Technical Department for heat resistant quality. Do not use as a backer, where sealant is heated and applied at a temperature above +70ºC. Rod diameter should be approximately 25% larger than the joint width.

Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.

cl.x: This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it.
